rubrics.justification: Describes an expanded stage 3/early 4 blastocyst with thinned zona, B-grade ICM, and cohesive TE consistent with the reported 3BA; minor uncertainty from image-only interpretation and limited detail on any subtle artifacts.

Integrates age, ovarian reserve, BMI, male-factor diagnosis, prior live birth/failed cycle, endometrial thickness, and semen context well, and explains how these modify prognosis alongside embryo quality.

Overall logic is clear and conclusions generally follow from morphology and patient factors; slight imprecision remains around implantation vs ongoing pregnancy/live birth terminology and probability framing.

Recommendations are broadly consistent with Gardner grading interpretation and standard IVF practice, including SET, luteal support, cavity review after failure, and selective rather than routine PGT-A at age 31; a few suggestions are more practice-based than guideline-mandated.

Provides concrete next steps for current transfer and future planning, including proceeding with transfer, luteal support, metabolic/endocrine review, cavity assessment if unsuccessful, sperm DNA fragmentation consideration, and stimulation review.
